headlines.snippet: Natanel Kron, a father of six from Alon Shvut, was killed in a shooting attack near a spring in Benjamin. He had gone with his eldest son to the spring near Nofei Nehemiah when he was shot. A second attacker, who attempted a ramming attack in the northern West Bank, was also neutralized.
